claim_boundary: Frozen FEM/PIDL c20s4 peak, physical cycle20/substep4/rawstep99/U=.11999988, native Q4/2x2GP, eta=0. Same unique e2dc learned-head initial network and audit-saved actual Phi/T; no initial SVD/reconstruction. Mechanical damage is exact conditional FEM outer18 damage, original UV boundary and Smooth B0 anchor are fixed. Intervention combines one completed hidden L-BFGS step with immediate Newton correction and per-pair L-BFGS history reset; not true variable projection or an isolated cadence ablation. Only head-closed complete pairs may become subsequent starts/final endpoints. All actual candidates are retained, including failed-head observations; no FEM-error endpoint selection. No whole-network convergence/capacity, physical-teacher, coupled fatigue-evolution or equal-cost optimizer ranking claim. RAW psi+ in fully degraded regions is secondary to ACTIVE g(d)psi+.
